item.tib: kun 'dus rin chen rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa nyi zer
item.coloph: rtsa rgyud kun 'dus gyi 'grel pa nyi zer drwa ba zhes bya ba/ paNaTi ta chen po kha che bon po dbal 'bar gyang ti gsas dang / lo tsA ba bod kyi bon po gsas mkhar me 'bar dang / bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' rnams kyis gtan la phab cing bshad pa'o// sgya 'phrul gyi bon la shin du sbyang (sbyangs pa) ba/ gyer spungs chen po mu la rad na'i lugs so/ de la shang pa byang gter gyi kun 'dus rin chen rtsa rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'di bsam yas skor (dkor)khang nas a tsa ra mi gsum kyi (gyis) gter nas thon/ ban b+he (d+he) mi gsum gyi zhu (gyis zhus)de yi gze bon sgrar po la/ rnel byed ne gus zhus/ de la zhang po sgom pa reng mo zhus/ de la rje lha ri gnyen pos zhus/ de la shang pa jo gzhon gy-i de la gtsang pa dbal shes/ de la g.yo ston nam mkha' rin chen gyis snya la zhang don gshen gzhon gyis de la gco bon gshen rab kyi de la gco btsun smon lam blo gros gyis zhus so//
